name: Summer House
description: Take the beach town of Montauk, New York by storm while following a group of nine friends who make the exclusive enclave their go-to party spot between Memorial Day and Labor Day — that is, when they're not hustling at their day jobs. You could say they work hard and party way harder.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer(s)
videos.overview: Kyle and his housemates are back and ready to “Send It!” in this half-hour special reflecting on their past three summers “share-housing” in the Hamptons.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer(s) 2021
videos.overview: Kyle and his housemates are back and ready to "Send It!" in this half-hour special reflecting on their past four summers "share-housing" in the Hamptons. Join the housemates as they spill the tea about what they know everyone did last summer(s).

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer(s) 2022
videos.overview: The housemates are back and ready to "Send It!" in this half-hour special reflecting on their past few summers "share-housing" in the Hamptons. The last few summers have been a wild ride full of fun and heartbreak. Join the crew (new and old) as they spill the tea about what they know everyone did last summer(s) and about what might be coming in the new season.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E6
videos.overview: On Season 8 Episode 6 of the Summer House After Show, (PART 1) Paige DeSorbo reveals how often she and Craig Connover do the deed, and West Wilson tells Jesse Solomon which Bravoleb he’s “so f—king tired of hearing about." (PART 2) The Summer Housemates weigh in on Carl and Lindsay’s “Friday Night Fights” cycle, and the ladies agree that Lindsay may have “bought into the fairytale” of her relationship with Carl too much.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E7
videos.overview: (PART 1) Carl Radke offers a surprising sentiment to Kyle Cooke, and Ciara Miller and Paige DeSorbo reveal what goes down in the cast’s two group chats. (PART 2) Carl reveals the one housemate that had the "more mature" response to the question about postponing, and the cast shares what they really think about newbie Jesse Solomon.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E8
videos.overview: (PART 1) The Housemates debate whether men crossing their legs is an "ick." Kyle Cooke explains why couples photos with Amanda Batula are so important to him.  (PART 2) Amanda Batula shares the real reason she hates it when Kyle Cooke stays out late. Kyle gets honest about his love for cookies.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E9
videos.overview: On the Summer House Season 8 After Show, (PART 1) Carl Radke pushes back on Lindsay Hubbards' accusations, and Ciara Miller reiterates her decision to take things slow with West. (PART 2) Ciara Miller and Amanda Batula react to Danielle Olivera's comments about Paige's relationship with Craig Conover, and Jesse Solomon offers a shocking contribution to the conversation about "smelling armpits."

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E10
videos.overview: (PART 1) Carl Radke reveals that "it wasn’t the first time" his parents had expressed about his relationship with Lindsay Hubbard, and Gabby Prescod opens up about her breakdowns. (PART 2) Carl Radke explains his shock at hearing that Lindsay Hubbard wanted to be a stay at home mom, while Lindsay gets "very passionate about the subject."

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E11
videos.overview: (PART 1) Lindsay Hubbard reacts to learning of Carl Radke’s parents’ concerns, and Carl Radke reveals that he's been hiding information to protect the relationship behind the scenes.  (PART 2)  Paige DeSorbo makes one thing clear about her relationship with Craig Conovoer: she is following her own timeline, and for good reason. Also, Paige explains the real reason she didn’t attend Lindsay’s bridal shower, and reveals the “very lovely gift” she got her instead.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E12
videos.overview: (PART 1) Kyle Cooke reacts to Amanda Batula’s evolving career goals, Carl Radke defends his desire to return to Loverboy, and West Wilson sheds light on his relationship status with Ciara Miller. (PART 2) Amanda Batula says she’s being “as supportive as she can,” but that if Kyle Cooke starts playing festivals she’s “out." Jesse Solomon, Paige DeSorbo, Ciara Miller, and West Wilson react to Paige confronting West about his relationship with Ciara.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E13
videos.overview: (PART 1) Lindsay becomes "activated," and Paige DeSorbo points out how Kyle Cooke's DJing "says everything" about his selfishness. (PART 2) Ciara wonders why Kyle is so quick to support and go out of his way to help Carl Radke, but immediately shuts down Amanda Batula.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E14
videos.overview: (PART 1) The Summer Housemates explain the origin of Jesse Solomon’s original song, and elaborate on the problem with Carl Radke asking Lindsay Hubbard to be softer. (PART 2) Kyle Cooke says the newest additions to the house were "an immediate breath of fresh air," and Lindsay Hubbard explains why she believes she was the "easy option" for Carl Radke.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S8 E15
videos.overview: (PART 1) Lindsay Hubbard and the cast give their perspectives on the break up.  (PART 2) Lindsay Hubbard and Carl Radke reveal the shocking details of what happened immediately after they left Montauk.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S9 E6
videos.overview: (PART 1) On the Summer House Season 9 Episode 6 After Show... Paige DeSorbo talks about the ups and downs of her relationship with Craig Conover, and Carl Radke opens up about his celibacy. (PART 2) Kyle Cooke defends his dinner drama with Craig Conover, and West Wilson says he's "learning lessons" when talking about his dating life.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S9 E7
videos.overview: On the Summer House Season 9 Episode 7 After Show... Carl Radke shares his thoughts on Lindsay Hubbard staying in their old apartment, and Jesse Solomon defends his comments to Ciara Miller.

videos.title: Summer House After Show S9 E8
videos.overview: (PART 1) The Summer House couple share more about Jesse Solomon's exclusivity proposal, and Lindsay Hubbard reveals if she'd ever make an appearance at Carl Radke's new bar. (PART 2) Lindsay Hubbard talks about how she possibly inspired the name of Carl Radke's Bar. Meanwhile, Lexi Wood opens up about how she felt about Toe Gate in the moment: "I sobbed after."

videos.title: Summer House
videos.overview: A group of New Yorkers rent a summerhouse in Montauk, N.Y.; Ashley and Lauren extend an invitation to their friend, Stassi, who sets her sights on Kyle; longtime friends Everett and Lindsay become intimate; new guy Carl plays the field.

videos.title: Codependence Day
videos.overview: There are fireworks on Independence Day; Lauren and Carl's relationship heats up in the bedroom; Kyle juggles two women at a party; love birds Everett and Lindsay's explosive antics prove they're anything but the perfect couple.

videos.title: Flirting With Disaster
videos.overview: Kyle confronts "perfect couple" Everett and Lindsay for disrupting his "single" summer. New house guest Jaclyn raises eyebrows with her Southern sensibility...or lack thereof. Carl gets caught in a lie that threatens his new relationship with Lauren.

videos.title: The Wrath of Wirkus
videos.overview: Lauren confronts Carl for lying about bringing a date to a wedding. Kyle dips his toe back into the ex-pool, despite everyone's warnings. Lindsay and Cristina's roommate drama boils over into full-on name calling and accusations.

videos.title: Wine, Whining, And Wieners
videos.overview: When the roommates go to a winery there is more "whine" than wine. As the drama between Lindsay and Cristina reaches its breaking point, someone may be evicted. Carl cools off on Lauren but warms up to Jaclyn at a beach bonfire.

videos.title: Model Behavior
videos.overview: The roommates go from blowing out candles for Kyle's birthday surprise to a blowout fight that derails everyone's good time and leave Lindsay and Everett on the brink of a breakup. Meanwhile, at Model Volleyball, Cristina serves up some juicy gossip that Jaclyn hasn't been a model friend to Lauren. And at long last, the Wirkus parents meet the infamous Carl.

videos.title: Hoedown Showdown
videos.overview: It's Lindsay's birthday and trouble's a brewing when Carl brings girls to the party, much to Lauren's dismay. Everett and Lindsay are on the outs, and Stephen spills a secret that may make the "on and off" again couple turn the switch off permanently.

videos.title: Sprained Relationships
videos.overview: With a scandalous secret looming over Lindsay and Everett's relationship, the pressure is on for the power couple to sink or swim. The roommates must come together to throw a race for charity, but not everyone will make it out in one piece. And finally, Cristina's meddling catches up to her when Lauren and Jaclyn go on the attack.

videos.title: The No Good, Very Bad Rosé Day
videos.overview: It's time for the annual Rosé Party, where Kyle meets a fellow blonde who may or may not be his drunken soul mate. It's Cristina vs everyone else, as the roommates take aim at her meddling ways.

videos.title: Winter Is Coming
videos.overview: Summer's over, and that means one last wild weekend with no regrets...or maybe a few. A Hamptons White Party turns into a messy affair when Kyle blows up at his ex-girlfriend Amanda over a lip-syncing scandal. Meanwhile, Cristina makes a dramatic exit, and Carl and Lauren's romantic pretzel twists one final time, when Carl disappears into the night.

videos.title: Passing The Torch
videos.overview: The gang is back for another summer; room selections cause things to get off to a rocky start; Stephen prepares to attend Gay Pride; Lindsay enjoys her freedom; Lauren and Danielle navigate their complicated feelings about sharing a house with Carl.

videos.title: Stars and Gripes
videos.overview: The second weekend of the summer is a big one and the crew prepares for their big July 4th bash. Kyle and Amanda talk about the next steps for their relationship while Carl and Lauren struggle with unresolved feelings. But when Danielle drops a bomb during a girls' day, everything comes to a head as the crew celebrates the country's independence in glorious fashion.

videos.title: Bonfire Insanity
videos.overview: Tensions are running high in the house, and Lindsay finds herself in the middle of the drama. The crew sets off for a sunset sail and beach bonfire, where these tensions boil over. The housemates return to the Hamptons, where Kyle and Amanda’s relationship faces setbacks. Danielle gains her housemates access to a very special place in the Hamptons with hopes that it will bring them all back to harmony.

videos.title: Don't Poke the Bear
videos.overview: With the summer house finally back to its free-spirited, hard partying ways, Amanda begins to show her frustration with Kyle’s continued boozy behavior and decides to let him have a weekend to himself. Lindsay gets in touch with her ex, Everett after failing to forget about him. Meanwhile, Lauren and Carl appear to have moved past the fiasco from the 4th and are back to being friends (with benefits) but Danielle continues to be an unwelcome third party in their relationship.

videos.title: Smashelorette
videos.overview: Lauren's twin sister, Ashley, is back in the Hamptons for their older sister's bachelorette weekend and she is not happy to see how cozy Carl and Lauren have gotten. Lindsay goes on her first date since Everett with a hot younger man. Kyle takes a big step with Amanda during a romantic dinner. And Stephen finally puts his issues with Carl out on the table.

videos.title: Mother Knows Best
videos.overview: The gang hosts their moms for the weekend. Lindsay tries to be a good friend. Kyle braces for his mother officially meeting Amanda’s mother.

videos.title: The Exes Are Coming
videos.overview: The moms’ weekend comes to a close with a revealing game before the gang all head back to the city. Everyone returns to the Hamptons ready to celebrate Kyle’s birthday weekend. Carl and Lauren clear the air of all the past weekend’s drama, Stephen goes on a blind date, and Danielle has a houseguest. Everything kicks into high gear when Kyle’s “revolutionary” 35th birthday party gets officially sent as Lindsay anxiously awaits the arrival of a very special guest.

videos.title: Say It With Flowers
videos.overview: Kyle's epic 35th birthday party ends with a major disruption from Lindsay; Stephen visits his family in Alabama; Amanda becomes frustrated by Kyle's behavior on a party bus; Carl and Lauren try out the friend zone, with questionable results.

videos.title: Summer Should Be Fun!
videos.overview: Kyle and Amanda’s relationship feels the strain of existing in the house while Lindsay attempts to get her single summer back on track and Lauren moves on from Carl with a few new prospects. Back from Alabama, Stephen is ready to take his fling more seriously but struggles with mixed signals and Carl asks for permission to let a new love interest spend the night.

videos.title: A House Divided
videos.overview: Kyle and Amanda attempt to repair their ever-growing rift; Carl chooses to put his cards on the table with his latest lady friend; Lindsay has some shocking news for Everett; Lauren's twin, Ashley, returns and sees some welcome changes in her sister.

videos.title: Lei It To Rest
videos.overview: It's the final weekend of summer and the house throws a massive luau. Ashley's husband arrives just as everyone is at odds with each other. Carl and Stephen confront their issues. And the housemates have had enough of Kyle and Amanda's drama.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: The gang sit down with Andy Cohen to discuss season two shenanigans and everything that went down on and off screen.

videos.title: Elephant in the Room
videos.overview: The housemates return to the Hamptons with several new friends in tow; unresolved issues between Kyle, Lindsay and Danielle quickly spread through the house; Carl vows to focus on his work and never hook up with a summer share housemate again.

videos.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Arguments
videos.overview: Tensions come to a head during a trip to the beach; Kyle and Amanda discuss moving in together; Carl struggles with meeting his sales quota; the housemates prepare for their annual Fourth of July party; Jordan flirts with both Danielle and Lindsay.

videos.title: Firework Starter
videos.overview: Fireworks continue as the 4th of July party winds down. Danielle gets a taste of Jordan, but after their tryst, he sets his eyes on Paige. Lindsay reconnects with Everett. Kyle and Amanda work together on their new startup. At Girls Night, the ladies break the news of Jordan’s true feelings to Danielle.

videos.title: Pantry Passion
videos.overview: Danielle forgives Jordan, who continues to wreak havoc in the house; Kyle woos Amanda; the housemates visit a vineyard; Hannah attends her grandfather's birthday party; Carl and Paige's flirtation leads him to violate his cardinal rule.

videos.title: The Grapes of Wrath
videos.overview: Jordan continues to offend his housemates; Paige isn't sure Carl checks off all her boxes; during a fight, Amanda admits she has cold feet about moving in with Kyle, and she issues an ultimatum.

videos.title: Swimming Uphill
videos.overview: Kyle changes his behavior; Carl and Paige go on a date in the city, but Paige still isn't sure if Carl is marriage material; Hannah confronts Lindsay about her backhanded compliments; the housemates head to a swanky St. Barth's party in the Hamptons.

videos.title: Epic Grand Gesture
videos.overview: The housemates throw a Christmas in July party and exchange secret Santa gifts; Kyle has a special present for Amanda; Hannah invites her British beau to the party; Carl vies for Paige's attention, but she ignores his advances, and he goes too far.

videos.title: Ring around the Rumor
videos.overview: Carl complains to Lindsay about Paige, and Lindsay's advice is overheard, causing a chain reaction among the women in the house. Meanwhile, as Kyle prepares to ask Amanda to take their relationship to the next level, another cheating rumour surfaces.

videos.title: Rumors Gone Wild
videos.overview: While Kyle is at his family reunion, Amanda plays single with Paige and Hannah. Danielle confronts Jordan about their tension, and possibly uncovers a secret. Lindsay confides in Danielle about another scandalous rumour, only for Danielle to end up telling Paige everything. Amanda, Kyle and their housemates celebrate Kyle's 36th birthday at a Monte Carlo night.

videos.title: True or False
videos.overview: Lindsay confronts Kyle about the shocking rumor; Kyle tells Amanda the real story; Carl's mother comes to town to surprise him; after Amanda ignores Kyle all week, he waits outside of her office desperate to confront her.

videos.title: Wing-Mom
videos.overview: Carl's mum drops by the summer house, much to Paige's delight. Hannah finally takes the next step with British Dave, and in an effort to move on from Everett, Lindsay goes on a date with Peyman. Amanda's parents make her rethink her decision to stay with Kyle after the cheating scandal, and Jordan reveals a secret.

videos.title: Pumped Up
videos.overview: Jordan finally meets a girl he'd bring home to mum, while Paige and Carl argue over who misled whom in their relationship. Stassi, Beau, Katie and Tom from `Vanderpump Rules' drop by the house and end up giving Lindsay some advice on love.

videos.title: The Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: The Vanderpumps continue their visit and Kyle accuses Paige of leading Carl on. Hannah tears into Jordan, Carl brings a date to the house, Tom has an emergency requiring a trip to the hospital, and Kyle reveals he's ready to propose to Amanda.

videos.title: Will You Bury Me?
videos.overview: It's the last weekend at the house, and the crew gets together for one more epic "death of summer" party; Carl gets closer to Kristen; Paige embraces being single; Kyle asks for Amanda's father's blessing to propose but gets a lukewarm response.

videos.title: The Big Bang
videos.overview: The summer starts off with a bang when Carl takes his friendship with Lindsay to the next level. While the returning housemates savour the juicy gossip, newbies Luke and Jules wonder what they've signed up for.

videos.title: Mice Will Play
videos.overview: With house parents Kyle and Amanda away at a family wedding, the `kids' are ready to run wild; Lindsay's friend, Danielle, joins the party; Luke pulls out all the stops to court Hannah, even though she's looking for a commitment from another guy.

videos.title: Worst. Date. Ever.
videos.overview: As the house gears up for its Fourth of July party, Jules wants to be friends with Paige, while Luke wants to be intimate with Hannah; Carl and Lindsay's first date is a full-blown disaster; Amanda slams the door in Kyle's face, setting him off.

videos.title: Red, White and Ewwww
videos.overview: The yearly Fourth of July bash is usually a high point for Kyle and his trusty mullet wig, but things are so rocky with Amanda that the only love he may get is from Carl; Lindsay gives Hannah's friend Armand the third degree.

videos.title: Hamptons Vice
videos.overview: Hannah invites her old buddy Jordan for the weekend and the housemates are surprised to learn that he has a romantic history with somebody in the house; when Hannah gets news about Armand, it helps her make a decision about Luke.

videos.title: Caged Heat
videos.overview: As Lindsay and Carl try to fix what's left of their friendship, Luke and Hannah's continuous flirtation leads to their first date going to new heights; it's a house divided for girls' and guys' night.

videos.title: Love Her, Boy
videos.overview: Kyle surprises Amanda with a shocking answer to a simple question; Luke revs up his courtship of Hannah with a motorcycle ride as Jules tries to break through a sexual roadblock; Carl and Lindsay try to move forward with new flings of their own.

videos.title: Exes and Oh-No's
videos.overview: Kyle and Amanda's mothers visit for the weekend; and the boys of "Summer House" behave badly; Jordan stuns Jules; Luke shocks the house with his relationship status; Carl still can't make things right with Lindsay.

videos.title: Pledge Master, Beer Lord
videos.overview: Kyle and Amanda turn the house into a petting zoo for Kyle's birthday; Paige laments that friend Hannah has fallen under Luke's spell; Carl invites his new fling to the house; a spat between Jules and Jordan escalates into a possible eviction.

videos.title: Clique Bait
videos.overview: As Kyle's birthday party comes to an end, Jules wonders if her time at the house is coming to a screeching halt; with Hannah distracted by Luke, Paige and Amanda don't hesitate to throw her under the bus.

videos.title: A Birthday to Die For
videos.overview: Lindsay turns the house into a crime scene for her murder mystery-themed birthday; Paige is put in an uncomfortable position as tension between Hannah and Amanda escalates over Hannah's involvement with Luke, who is still hung up on an ex

videos.title: Offensive Rebound
videos.overview: When Hannah calls it quits with Luke, Paige and Amanda are thrilled to get their friend back; a day trip to the orchard leaves a sour taste in everyone's mouth; a night of passion leaves one house mate feeling satisfied, but others feeling betrayed.

videos.title: America’s Roast Wanted
videos.overview: Paige and Amanda confront Hannah about her steamy night; Carl and Jules bond over their summer of relationship mishaps; barbs are exchanged at the first-ever house roast, but not everybody can take the heat.

videos.title: Rave Goodbye
videos.overview: It's the final weekend at the Summer House, but before the housemates celebrate with an epic end of summer rave, it's a house divided for Kyle and Amanda's bachelor and bachelorette festivities.

videos.title: Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: The Summer House crew continues to bring the heat in this never-before-seen footage from Season 4. From fiery flings to rocky relationships, get the inside scoop on moments you didn't see this season.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Andy welcomes the cast of "Summer House" for an online reunion. Lindsay Hubbard talks about the clique that formed in the house. Luke Gulbranson and Hannah Berner talk about their relationship. Carl Radke has news.

videos.title: Kiss and Don't Tell
videos.overview: Lindsay is trying to take her relationship with Stephen to the next level; Paige decides if Perry is the one for her; the housemates learn that Luke is bringing a new girl to the house.

videos.title: Let the Good Times Roll
videos.overview: Carl hosts a reception for his mom's virtual wedding; Danielle throws a roller-skating party; the housemates want to throw Kyle a birthday party.

videos.title: The Sandwich Between Us
videos.overview: While the cold war between Luke and Hannah shows no signs of warming, Lindsay wonders if she is actually the priority in her relationship with Stephen; the housemates plan a family dinner to get back on track, but it leaves the house divided.

videos.title: Trash Talk
videos.overview: The crew decides to let loose in an all-out mullet extravaganza, the debauchery continues; much to the chagrin of Paige and Amanda, Hannah and Luke reconcile; the real war begins when Kyle calls a house meeting.

videos.title: Best Frenemies
videos.overview: Luke thinks a flirtatious flower delivery will get his relationship with Ciara back on track; Stephen attempts to cheer Lindsay up with a romantic birthday dinner; Hannah and Amanda's friendship takes a turn; Carl receives devastating news.

videos.title: Power-Pointless
videos.overview: Kyle is enraged to find his housemates have more laid-back plans for their Saturday night; Lindsay finally receives a grand gesture from Stephen; Carl returns from Pittsburgh to find the house in shambles.

videos.title: Medium at Large
videos.overview: Kyle tries to make amends with Hannah; Lindsay grapples with ending her relationship with Stephen; rumours spread like wildfire when Hannah receives an explosive tip from her psychic.

videos.title: Crawl Me Maybe
videos.overview: Lindsay and Luke's maybe-not-so-innocent friendship is called into question when Amanda and Paige confront them about the juicy hook-up rumour; sparks fly between Ciara and Carl; the guys corner Luke and demand he account for his behaviour.

videos.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go?
videos.overview: A pub crawl devolves into a serious conflict between the boys, causing Luke to leave the house; Lindsay wonders if she made a mistake when she broke up with Stephen; Kyle surprises Amanda for their two-year engagement anniversary.

videos.title: Couples Retreat
videos.overview: With Stravy's return, the house is abuzz about Lindsay's chaotic relationship; Hannah and Danielle take phone relationships to the next level; Luke is blindsided by information about Hannah and Des; Paige questions her relationship with Perry.

videos.title: Derby Days
videos.overview: Lindsay decides it's time to take her relationship to the next level and make her ring size known; Carl throws a Derby-themed party, complete with a housemates horse race; Hannah finds herself in the hot seat.

videos.title: Makeups and Breakups
videos.overview: It's the final days at the house and to commemorate the end of summer, the housemates throw a wedding-themed party for Kyle and Amanda; Hannah, Paige and Ciara navigate their complicated friendships; Lindsay and Stravy continue their relationship.

videos.title: Reunion (1)
videos.overview: Ciara, Luke and Hannah revisit the unraveling of their love triangle; Lindsay admits what Stravy was really doing in the house when he claimed to be working; the housemates confront Hannah about her recent statements in the press and on podcasts.

videos.title: Reunion (2)
videos.overview: Carl discusses his struggles with sobriety; Luke accuses Hannah of turning the house against him; Paige is caught in the middle of Hannah and Amanda's issues; Hannah is confronted about what she and Des did in Kyle and Amanda's bathroom.

videos.title: Where's My Lover, Boy?
videos.overview: Kyle's late-night shenanigans are suspicious to fiancée Amanda and raise a red flag to their friends; an old flame returns and instantly heats things up for Paige; Lindsay drops a bomb on Carl that no one saw coming.

videos.title: Star-spangled Drama
videos.overview: The housemates throw their annual bash; after a big disagreement, Amanda focuses on having fun while Kyle struggles to get in the mood to party.

videos.title: Heartbreak in the Hamptons
videos.overview: After a rocky first weekend, Kyle and Amanda try to find sturdy ground in their relationship; Carl tries to get to know Ciara better, but soon realizes there might be someone else in the way.

videos.title: Charmed, I'm Not Sure
videos.overview: After a shocking revelation about Craig, Paige gives her Southern charmer a taste of his own medicine with her Italian romancer; Lindsay has the time of her life as her "Hot Hubbs Summer" continues; Mya and Carl begin to form a bond.

videos.title: Birthday Hex
videos.overview: Following their passionate spin the bottle kiss, Ciara and Alex wonder if there's more between them than physical attraction; Paige's heart begins to drift away from Craig and toward Andrea, who's looking for something real.

videos.title: Summer Should Be Kinky
videos.overview: Andrea is fully in his element throwing an epic 50 Shades of Summer party, and he continues to seduce Paige in the process; while Lindsay is away for the weekend, Carl returns to the Hamptons in a better place, thanks to a new lady in his life.

videos.title: One Basket, Too Many Eggs
videos.overview: Ciara gives Alex a chance, while Paige makes a long-distance confession to Craig that leaves him livid. With Kyle and Amanda's rocky relationship on full display, the ladies of the house take it upon themselves to stage an intervention with Amanda. And Lindsay learns some life-changing news with Danielle by her side.

videos.title: A Twisted Fairytale
videos.overview: Lindsay throws an epic, twisted fairy-tale birthday bash to celebrate turning 35; when Austen arrives, Ciara isn't the only princess in the house who has eyes for this Southern Prince Charming; Paige and Craig's relationship moves in a new direction.

videos.title: Happily Ever Never
videos.overview: Love is in the air as Lindsay's fairytale birthday continues; Carl's new fling seems to be fitting right in, and Mya hits it off with a potential suitor; Andrea does his best to put himself back on the market.

videos.title: That's Not Amore!
videos.overview: Things between Carl and his crush start to heat up; Craig is back in town, and Paige wonders if she's finally ready to take things to the next level; Andrea brings an Italian dinner tradition to the Hamptons.

videos.title: Hurricane Warning
videos.overview: After a heated exchange at dinner, the house attempts to undo the damage; Craig reveals his intentions with Paige; Lindsay admits she may have feelings for Austen; with time running out before their wedding, Kyle pressures Amanda for a prenup.

videos.title: Playing with Fire
videos.overview: At Danielle's beachside bonfire, Lindsay's heart is burning for her latest suitor; Mya is hesitant about her new relationship; when Andrea breaks down about his recent heartbreak, Paige wonders if he was using her the past few months.

videos.title: Pre-nope
videos.overview: The last weekend of summer starts with a bang; tensions rise among the housemates at dinner; Lindsay's Hot Hubbs pursuits land her back in the hot seat.

videos.title: Keep Prom and Carry On
videos.overview: The housemates let loose with a prom party; Lindsay and Carl explore a flirtatious side of their friendship; the arrival of an unexpected guest leaves Paige speechless; Kyle and Amanda are feeling the pressure.

videos.title: A Happy Sending
videos.overview: Kyle and Amanda's big day approaches; Lindsay and Carl address their feelings towards each other; Paige and Craig finally put a label on their relationship; Kyle and Amanda are hit with a blow that no one saw coming.

videos.title: Reunion (1)
videos.overview: As the Summer House reunion kicks off, Lindsay defends her Hot Hubbs Summer; Carl tarnishes his friendship with a surprising housemate along the way; Also, Danielle's relationship is questioned.

videos.title: Reunion (2)
videos.overview: The reunion concludes with Kyle and Amanda giving an update on their prenup question; Lindsay reveals why she stopped drinking and gives insight into her romance with Carl.

videos.title: Star Spangled Feud
videos.overview: The housemates are back in the Hamptons; Carl and Lindsay are living their version of a real-life fairy tale; Kyle and Mya see changes in Carl and have theories behind his personality shift; three new housemates join the party.

videos.title: A Line in the Sand
videos.overview: Kyle and Carl finally address their issues; Mya confronts Lindsay over their tense conversation in Los Angeles; Gabby continues her pursuit of a hot prospect; Ciara joins the share house.

videos.title: A Cup of LoyalTea
videos.overview: Danielle and Gabby agree to move past shady men; Chris takes his shot with Ciara; Kyle is frustrated with Carl and Lindsay; the girls enjoy an afternoon of sipping and spilling the tea until a revelation from Danielle threatens to derail the party.

videos.title: Pillow Talk
videos.overview: Carl returns to the Loverboy offices and his work issues with Kyle come to a head; back in the Hamptons, Andrea rejoins the crew with hopes for an Italian dinner do-over; a slumber party turns from wild fun into a bad dream for the housemates.

videos.title: The Hangover
videos.overview: The slumber party turns into a nightmare when a blowup between Kyle and Lindsay leaves Carl stuck in the middle; Gabby leads the charge on the first bash of the summer; a confession from Danielle turns Lindsay's world upside down.

videos.title: Panic at the Disco
videos.overview: The housemates throw their first big party of the summer as Kyle confronts the fallout from his outburst at the slumber party; Sam's encounter with a new man reignites old insecurities.

videos.title: Rise and Wine
